groups.label: Word Stress & Syllable Prominence
rules: Most 2-syllable nouns stress the first syllable (DOC-tor, TEA-cher).
-teen numbers stress the second syllable (thir-TEEN), -ty numbers stress the first (THIR-ty).

groups.label: Sentence Stress & Schwa /ə/
groups.definition: Prominence of content words and weak forms
rules: Content words (nouns, main verbs, adjectives) are stressed.
Function words are unstressed and often use the schwa sound /ə/.
